itemmilestonelog.configuration.allowDisc: Allow players to opt out of Discord posts with /milestonelog discordoptout. When false, the command is disabled and saved preferences are ignored (but preserved).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.allowLook: Allow every player to view other players' records with /milestonelog lookup <player>. When false, only operators (and the singleplayer/LAN host) can look others up; looking yourself up always works.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.announceP: Announce to all online players when someone completes all targets of a preset. When false, only the completing player is notified (if notifyPlayer is enabled).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.announceW: Announce server-wide world-first records to all online players.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.autoBacku: Back up MilestoneData to <world>/itemmilestonelog/backups/ on world save (at most once per hour) and on server stop. Independent of exportImportEnabled.
Maximum number of automatic backup files to keep per world (1-20).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.broadcast: Broadcast milestone records to all online players in addition to the player themself.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.chatItemH: Show the item when hovering an item name in this mod's chat messages. Tag targets show the first item of the tag by registry ID; the text itself is unchanged.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.clientBac: Rotate local backups of this client's cached milestone data on disconnect and when connecting to another server. Local display only; never sent to the server or written to SavedData.
Number of local client cache backups to keep (1-10). Only files in config/itemmilestonelog-client/backups/ are pruned.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.exitAutoE: Write one local export on disconnect (client display only). The export file writer ships in a later client PR; this key records the preference.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.localCach: Cache the last received milestone sync snapshot on this client so it can be viewed offline. Local display only; cached data is always labelled as an offline view and is never sent to the server.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.lowPowerM: Reduce client-side refresh frequency and disable cosmetic effects. Displayed information and button layout are unchanged; no server setting is affected.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.defaultTa: Item IDs that every player tracks by default, e.g. minecraft:diamond or minecraft:diamond#100 for a quantity. Players can add their own targets on top of these.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordDi: Send a periodic Discord digest of milestones recorded since the previous digest. Uses the Discord webhook, scope, embed, and language settings.
Interval in days between Discord digest messages (1-30).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordLa: Language for Discord webhook notifications (en_us or ja_jp).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordNo: Post preset completions to Discord when a webhook URL is configured. Independent of announcePresetCompletion and discordNotifyScope.
Which milestones to send to Discord: all or world_first.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordSi: Send normal (non-world-first) milestone posts to Discord without triggering notifications. Does not affect world-first posts, groups containing a world first, preset completions, digests, or the test command.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.discordUs: Send Discord milestone notifications as rich embeds instead of plain text.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.displayTi: Timezone ID used for server-formatted dates (chat, log, Discord, exports). Leave empty for the server default; examples: UTC, Asia/Tokyo, +09:00. The GUI always uses the player's local timezone.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.exportImp: Enable milestone export and import commands (applies to OPs as well).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.firstJoin: Preset IDs applied automatically as personal targets the first time a player joins this world. Leave empty to disable; players can remove the applied targets.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.groupSimu: Group notifications when 3 or more milestones are recorded for the same player in the same tick. Set to false to send every record immediately.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.guiWorldF: Show a star mark (★) on recorded milestones in the GUI for which you hold the world first.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.ignoreCre: Do not record anything while a player is in creative or spectator mode. Items still carried when switching back to survival are not recorded either until they leave the inventory.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.itemToolt: Show milestone status lines at the end of item tooltips on this client. This is a client-side display setting controlled by each player's own config file.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.loginWorl: Send a chat summary when a player logs in, listing world firsts recorded while they were away. Requires a stored last-seen time and is skipped while muteBroadcasts is enabled. Shows up to 5 entries plus the remaining count.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.milestone: Optional server command to run (without a leading slash) when a milestone is recorded (empty = disabled). Supports player, UUID, item, count, playtime, and world-first placeholders; use a function command for multiple commands.
Sound event ID to play when a milestone is recorded.
Play a sound to the player when a milestone is recorded (independent of notifyPlayer).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.notificat: Group in-game and Discord notifications from this many ticks into one flush (1 = current per-tick behaviour).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.notifyPla: Send the player a chat message when one of their target items is recorded.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.presetCom: Optional server command run when a player completes all targets of a preset. Empty = disabled. Placeholders: player, uuid, preset, builtin.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.presetsEn: Enable preset commands and preset management in the GUI. Existing preset files are never deleted.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.progressA: Where progress alerts are shown (chat / action bar / both / off). Individual players can override this.
Minimum target quantity required for progress alerts (2-1000000).
Percentage thresholds (1-99) at which to send progress alerts for quantity targets. Duplicates are ignored and values are evaluated in ascending order. Leave empty to disable.
Notify the player in chat when a quantity target crosses a progress threshold (independent of notifyPlayer).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.scanInter: Inventory scan interval in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Lower is more precise but slightly more expensive.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.scoreboar: Optional scoreboard objective name for each player's milestone record count (empty = disabled). Use a dedicated name matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,32}$; clearing this setting does not delete existing objectives or scores.

Optional scoreboard objective name for each player's world-first count (empty = disabled). Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,32}$ and differ from scoreboardObjective; clearing this setting does not delete existing objectives or scores.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.showFirst: Show a one-time chat tip when a player joins for the first time.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.strictPre: Reject a config-folder or datapack preset entirely when any element fails validation, instead of skipping only the invalid elements. Includes failures and invalid groups also reject it; built-in presets are never rejected.

itemmilestonelog.configuration.pinHudMax: Maximum number of pinned targets shown in the HUD (1-10, default 5).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.pinHudAnc: Corner of the screen used by the pinned-target HUD: top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.pinHudAut: Fade the pinned-target HUD for three seconds after damage, chat input or a screen opening.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.pinHudSca: Font scale of the pinned-target HUD in percent (50-200); widgets are not resized.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.accessibl: Include pinned-target HUD rows in Minecraft's standard narration. No new narrator is added.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.hudHighCo: Draw pinned-target HUD rows in white on black instead of the default colours.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.reducedMo: Skip the HUD fade so it appears and disappears immediately. No information is removed.
command.itemmilestonelog.imlclient.pin.n: Target is not in the current sync snapshot: %s
message.itemmilestonelog.pin_no_sync: No synced target data is available; pins can only be added while connected to a modded server.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.tooltipMa: Maximum milestone status lines on an item tooltip (1-10, default 3).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.tooltipSh: Show target rows on item tooltips (default on).
Show recorded rows on item tooltips (default on).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.tooltipSo: Status order: default, target-first or recorded-first (default keeps the shipped order).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.tooltipSt: Status colour: default, gray, white or gold (default = the shipped grey).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.tooltipTa: Prefix tag target rows with the tag name (default on); the status row itself is kept.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.externalT: Add one shared milestone line to those mods' tooltip panels when installed (default off).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.searchCom: Suggest up to five matching item names in the item-picker hint (default on).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.searchHis: Remember the last 50 item-picker queries locally (default on).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.clientExp: Subdirectory under config/itemmilestonelog-client/ for /imlclient export files (empty uses exports/). Absolute paths and '..' are rejected.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.streamSta: Write status.txt/status.json for OBS under config/itemmilestonelog-client/stream/ (default off). No player names or URLs are written.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.screensho: Capture one screenshot when a new milestone record arrives (default off). Open screens are skipped.
command.itemmilestonelog.imlclient.expor: Export your own records locally: /imlclient export <json|csv>

command.itemmilestonelog.imlclient.backu: No local cache is available to back up.
command.itemmilestonelog.imlclient.carry: Carry your own pins and targets locally: /imlclient carry <export|import|list>
Carried %s local target(s); no server change was made.

message.itemmilestonelog.carry_local_onl: Local-only candidates; nothing was sent to the server.
message.itemmilestonelog.stream_status_w: OBS status files are now written under %s.
message.itemmilestonelog.screenshot_skip: Screenshot skipped: a screen with secrets may be visible.

No cached data for this server.
command.itemmilestonelog.imlclient.profi: Saved %s display override(s) for this server.
Connect to a server before editing a profile.
message.itemmilestonelog.cache_invalid: The local cache could not be read; showing no offline data.
message.itemmilestonelog.offline_readonl: Offline view: this button is read-only and nothing was sent.
message.itemmilestonelog.offline_view: [Offline view] Showing the last locally cached snapshot.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.clientEff: Play one small particle effect when a record arrives (default off). The channel stays registered, so no relogin is needed.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.chatStyle: Restyle only this mod's own chat messages: default, subtle, bold, high-contrast (default = unchanged).
itemmilestonelog.configuration.clientSou: Play the record notification sound on this client (default on). Volume is unchanged.
Play the world-first notification sound on this client (default on). Volume is unchanged.
Play the preset-completion notification sound on this client (default on). Volume is unchanged.
Play the progress-alert notification sound on this client (default on). Volume is unchanged.
itemmilestonelog.configuration.showRecor: Append the local HH:mm record time to GUI record rows (default off). No extra row height or server timezone.
message.itemmilestonelog.key_conflict: Two controls share key %s; nothing was changed automatically.
message.itemmilestonelog.copied_recent: Copied the most recent record to the clipboard.
message.itemmilestonelog.no_recent_recor: No recent record with a usable time is available.
